headline: Casa Limoneros / Quaterna Arquitectos
context: Casa Limoneros draws from the vernacular architecture of Valle de Bravo through a contemporary interpretation. Its pitched, clay-tiled roofs recall the region's distinctive building tradition, while the material palette establishes a restrained dialogue with the surrounding lands
